# GEMU® Surface

> GEMU® Surface is a Foshan-based manufacturer of architectural wall panel systems in WPC, SPC and PVC. The company supplies the Philippine market direct from its own factory with FOB pricing, physical sample boxes and container-load delivery. Product lines cover fluted & slat, wood grain, marble & stone, and 3D & sculptural surfaces, specified for tropical heat, humidity, termites and salt-laden coastal air.

## Company facts

- Brand name: GEMU® Surface
- Business type: Manufacturer (OEM / ODM), factory-direct supply
- Location: Foshan, Guangdong, China
- Primary market: Philippines — Manila, Cebu, Quezon City and nationwide
- Sales contact: sky@fsgemu.cn · WhatsApp +86 130 7630 0041
- Website: https://www.fsgemu.cn/
- Range: 12 series across 4 surface families, 3 core materials
- Warranty: 15 years (colour stability, structural integrity, fixing performance)
- Water absorption: under 0.5% by weight across all ranges
- Thermal movement: fixing systems allow 3 mm per metre
- Certifications and test reports: available on request

## Ordering and logistics

- Samples: mixed-colour sample orders start at one carton; sample boxes dispatch within 48 hours
- Project pricing: applies from 300 m²
- Container rates: from a 20 ft load
- Custom colour: matched from a physical swatch or RAL reference; co-extrusion runs start at 1,500 m² with a two-week sampling lead time
- Shipping: FOB Foshan to Manila, Cebu and other Philippine ports; container orders typically run 15–25 days including production and consolidation
- Services: cut-to-length, container-load consistency, full technical documentation, installation support

## Product families

- Fluted & Slat — vertical slat and great-wall profiles that add rhythm, depth and acoustic softness to a wall.
- Wood Grain — timber-look panels in warm oak, walnut and teak grains.
- Marble & Stone — polished stone and marble-look surfaces for feature walls and wet areas.
- 3D & Sculptural — relief-carved and sculptural panels for statement surfaces.

## Core materials

- WPC (Wood Plastic Composite) — wood fibre fused with polymer for the warm grain and solid feel of timber, with no termites, rot or sealing. Density 0.60–0.85 g/cm³. Profile 160 × 24 × 2900 mm. Cuts and screws like wood. Best for feature walls, living areas and hotels.
- SPC (Stone Plastic Composite) — rigid mineral core that will not warp or bow in tropical heat. Density 1.90–2.10 g/cm³. Best for lobbies, corridors and commercial spaces where flatness and impact resistance matter.
- PVC (Polyvinyl Chloride) — lightweight, cost-effective, waterproof panels for ceilings, wet areas and decorative cladding.
- Profiles — fluted, great-wall, 3D-carved and flat profiles across hundreds of colours, with custom colour matching from a physical swatch.

## Applications

Residential · Hospitality · Commercial · Wet Areas · Kitchen · Bedroom

## How the company works

1. Specify — the client sends drawings or a mood board; GEMU matches series, profile and colour to climate and budget.
2. Sample — a physical sample box is shipped to the client's office to check colour, grain and fixing detail in real light.
3. Confirm — pricing, cut-list and lead time are locked in, and technical drawings are issued for the contractor.
4. Deliver — container-loaded, documented and tracked to site, with installation support on standby.
